caveats: Google Maps served a limited view for every listing: star ratings were captured but review counts were not displayed, so review volume is unknown for all ten businesses.
Google web search was CAPTCHA-blocked from this IP; Google Maps place panels and the businesses' own sites were used instead, supplemented by web_search and directory pages.

Phone-width (390px) screenshots were taken for Bleu Apothecary, Results Boxing, Results Performance and Semper Fit Me; mobile notes for the other sites come from responsive markup plus tel:/viewport checks (inference where no screenshot was taken).

Results Boxing's images returned 403 from its CloudFront CDN and rendered as broken icons in Chrome for us. A CDN-side block for this network cannot be fully ruled out, so treat 'images broken for all visitors' as likely but unconfirmed.
Owner, size and budget judgements are inferences from public signals, not statements by the businesses.
SETS Hybrid Training was excluded as a three-location regional brand; site and booking are brand-level, so a local engagement is unlikely.
data_gaps: Review counts and review text for all businesses (Google limited view; no Yelp/Birdeye review text opened), so complaint patterns about slow replies or missed calls could not be checked.
